name: Gamma
summary: Create presentations, documents and websites with AI.
description: Gamma generates presentations, documents, websites and social posts from a prompt, outline or imported file, with editable designs and online sharing. It is known for replacing slide design work with fluid web-native cards. The Free plan gives 400 one-time credits and up to 10 slides per prompt; Plus is $9/seat/month billed annually ($12 monthly) and Pro $18/month billed annually.

pricing.label: Freemium
pricing.note: The Free plan gives 400 one-time credits and up to 10 slides per prompt; Plus is $9/seat/month billed annually ($12 monthly) and Pro $18/month billed annually.

howToUse.title: Describe what you want to make
howToUse.description: Gamma's help center says to start from the dashboard prompt. A sentence is enough, and you can paste notes, attach files, or pick a template.

howToUse.title: Choose Plan, Express, or Research
howToUse.description: Plan asks questions and shows a plan before building. Express goes straight to a first draft. Research pulls web sources and only works with Plan.

howToUse.title: Approve the plan
howToUse.description: In Plan mode, answer the questions, review the plan, and give the go-ahead. The help article says the agent does not build until you do.

howToUse.title: Review and ask for changes
howToUse.description: The help article says the agent builds the gamma, and you can tell it what to change afterward.

features_fr: Crée des présentations, des documents et des sites Web avec l'IA.

Gamma génère des présentations, des documents, des sites Web et des publications sociales à partir d'une invite, d'un plan ou d'un fichier importé, avec des conceptions modifiables et un partage en ligne.
Il est connu pour remplacer le travail de conception de diapositives par des cartes Web natives fluides.
Le plan gratuit offre 400 crédits uniques et jusqu'à 10 diapositives par invite ; Plus est de 9 $/siège/mois facturé annuellement (12 $ par mois) et Pro 18 $/mois facturé annuellement.
